newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN SIOEN STARTS BRUSSELS TRADE AT 1,580 BFR.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN SIOEN STARTS BRUSSELS TRADE AT 1,580 BFR.

text.p: Shares in Belgian textile firm Sioen Industries on Friday started trade on the Brussels bourse at 1,580 Belgian francs each, dealers said.
An initial public offering of 30.1 percent of its capital, or 600,000 shares, at 1,400 francs per share, was five times oversubscribed.
The firm had group net profit of 130 million francs in the first half of this year, after 173 million in full year 1995 and 81 million francs in 1994.
Sioen shares are listed on the Brussels stock exchange's second-tier double-fixing market.
